retention: Keep all historical generations; never remove earlier heroes
rule: Always include current hero generation and next generation in hero database, investment comparisons, rally leader and joiner analysis
rollForward: When kingdom generation increases, automatically extend target to currentGeneration+1 without deleting old generations
generation5Status: forward-looking; distinguish released, previewed, community-reported and unverified skills

evaluation.currentHero: actual owned stars, partial stars, skills, gear and role
evaluation.replacement: role-by-role effects, conditions, synergies, investment and opportunity cost
evaluation.futureGeneration: compare available or documented next-gen alternatives; do not invent costs, hero strength or availability
evaluation.whale: optimize maximum team performance; no automatic 4-star spending cap
evaluation.others: optimize ROI and preserve resources where next generation may offer better value

designFreeze: Do not modify frozen Command Center
